svg.title: KAREN OS daily review architecture
svg.desc: Muse briefs the owner from Notion, Google Calendar, Gmail and GitHub; scripts on the Mac keep Notion current and dispatch Claude Code or Codex by remaining usage; agents open pull requests the owner merges; approved drafts post to LinkedIn through Composio.
svg.text: Brief → decide → dispatch → notify → approve, morning and evening. Every product box can be swapped for another that does the same job.
Read the brief on your phone
Ranks the day against your goals
Personal tasks you tick off · daily plans · check-ins
Engineering digest (written by script, not AI)
LinkedIn drafts waiting for your approval
Engineers: one is picked per issue
Issues = tasks · labels = status · PRs = review
Notifies you when a PR is up (GitHub app)
You merge = approval; agents never merge
Same pipeline for direct and dispatched work
⑥ scripts read issues, PRs, labels
Direct work: you ask Claude Code or Codex
③ read events and mail, write plan blocks · ⑨ approved draft is posted · dashed = later
